articles.title: What Should My Builder be Charging for Their Overhead and Profit?
articles.description: Remodeling contractors should aim to achieve a gross profit margin of approximately 25% to 40%, which includes their overhead and profit. This typically translates into a profit margin of 4% to 7%, representing profit after all operating expenses are accounted for.
